candidate.name: Muhammad Rayyan Ahmed
credentials: M.Sc. Data Science (in progress), TU Ilmenau

letter.opening: I am applying for the Working Student position in AI Research. Reading a new paper and turning it into a working experiment is the kind of work I enjoy most, and I have done it with retrieval methods in my own project.
letter.profile_intro: I am an M.Sc. Data Science student at TU Ilmenau, a German university, with a B.S. in Artificial Intelligence, including coursework on how large language models work.

achievements.impact: I built DocuMind (github.com/Rayyan3079/documind-rag), a RAG system in which I implemented hybrid retrieval with Reciprocal Rank Fusion and raised MRR from 0.748 to 0.898
I designed an evaluation harness with hit rate, MRR and an LLM judge, and used it to trace failures to their cause
in a team project I compared graph-based and language-model embeddings for clustering text

letter.problems_section: I would read new papers, test the promising ones in clear experiments, bring what works onto your platform and share results with the team. Legal tech is new to me, and I would learn the domain quickly.
letter.closing: I can work 20 hours per week, hybrid in Berlin/Potsdam, and am willing to relocate. I would be glad to discuss the role.
letter.language_closing: I work in English (IELTS 8.0) and am currently learning German (A1).
